title: When Not to Use Agents
youtube_title: When Not to Use Agents: Judgment Is the Real Skill | The Agentic Crew, Ch. 17
description: The best agentic engineers aren't the ones who use agents most. They're the ones who know when to put them away. Small tasks, architecture, security-critical code, learning, messy code bases and your own craft are where the overhead or the risk outweighs the leverage.
